mutants.description: The asynchronous reset clears the two shift registers but leaves both fault counts alone, relying on the idle clear to zero them after reset is released.
mutants.reason: If rst_n is asserted while the converter is running with faulted cycles counted, fault_count_run_out and fault_count_ss_out keep showing the old counts for the whole reset, where they should read 0. They stay that way until the first clock after release, and at power-up they start undefined.

mutants.description: The S_RUN window trip is also qualified by the live comparator flag ('overcurrent still present'), so a run window that holds trip_run faulted cycles does not trip while cp_sync is low.
mutants.reason: In S_RUN, once fault_count_run reaches trip_run, window_trip should assert and stay high. With this fault it is held low whenever cp_sync is low, so an intermittent overcurrent that fills the window trips late, or never trips if cp_sync is low whenever the count is at or above the threshold.
